pharmacist.scene: Handheld front-camera selfie video in the back of the pharmacy, phone at arm's length, slight natural shake. The pharmacist in the white coat talks directly to camera like a friendly expert giving a quick tip on social media, confident, expressive eyebrows, one open-hand gesture entering the frame, warm smile at the end. The shelves and boxes behind her stay unchanged.
pharmacist.voice: Her voice: French woman in her early forties, native Parisian French, clear, warm, confident and reassuring, natural conversational social-media pace.
